blurb: Hope Reins serves children aged 5-18 who have experienced trauma, providing free sessions at their 38-acre ranch with rescued horses. The program focuses on healing through safe relationships, connection with horses, and restoration in Christ. They also offer an online Academy to train others to start similar ministries.
extraNote: All sessions are free of charge thanks to donors · Applications for services are currently closed; no confirmed reopening date · 38-acre ranch at 8420 Wake Forest Hwy, Raleigh, NC
